verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only per-item operations: create, update, lock/unlock and delete individual cards, label transactions, and list or filter transactions. There is no batch or bulk endpoint, and no documented way to act on many items in one call. Pulling all transactions for a billing period is paginated retrieval, not a bulk operation, so it is only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
